Correct a Season Anchor behind the Sesong edit preview

leskraas/trainm8#673 · design, run 1 · unattended · one variant

Chosen: Handling først, with 4 build changesrun 19 decisions + 4 from the criticrisk: easy-week pre-fill cuts the seasonone-way door: what Plan's lead shows per track

Overview

evidence:handling-forst-mobile.png
evidence:handling-forst-desktop.png

Handling først, the only variant: Endre volumet on Plan's lead opens Endre sesongen on a new Endre startnivået edit. The athlete picks one of three acts as choice cards, gets one preview with every changed week (before → after, Regnet ut or Satt selv, and a tap shows how the figure was worked out), and confirms.

Comparison

Handling først Chosen
Axis positionInteraction model: choose the act first (one form, three acts, one preview), between "a list of segments, each with its own actions" and "only a fresh start from a week"
GainOne form and one digest, so it fits the existing EditShell and preview contract unchanged. Mid-season it opens on the act that will not be refused (a fresh start from the first unbegun week, pre-filled with that week's own target), so the usual path never meets a refusal
CostThe segments are a picker, not a visible list, so "when have I re-anchored" is less visible here than in the Avansert editor. That editor stays. Three choice cards cost ~210 px before the fields at 390 px
Criteria held10 hold · 2 partly · 0 miss (critic). Partly: the re-lay and Session Ownership are only stated; the Avansert anchor editor is not drawn
Worst caseThree tracks, six segments (one outside the plan), 29 changed weeks, long phase names and a 0-km override all hold at 390 and 320 px with no horizontal overflow after two fixes (below). Critic found one break: a fresh start from an easy week with the pre-fill left as it is cuts the season by ~30 % (Broken). Also the confirm sits ~2,000 px down on a 29-row preview (Fragile)
Build costnone (one variant)
StatusChosen

Decisions

  1. What does Plan's lead show for each endurance track with a Season Anchor? A row with the track (in its ink), the first unbegun week's target ("Uke 46: 48,5 km") and an Endre volumet pill. Strength gets a line pointing to Avansert. one-way: users see it, no criterion names its content
  2. Which act does the edit open on? If the segment in force began before the first unbegun week, it opens on Start på nytt fra uke N, pre-filled with week N's current target. Otherwise it opens on Endre tallet for that segment.
  3. How are the three acts offered? As radio choice cards (RadioGroupField) feeding one season-anchor edit with action: add | set | remove. Fjern is shown only when a removable segment exists, and the earliest segment is never one of its options.
  4. Where does the edit sit? First in Endre sesongen, the formula's order (ADR 0040 §3). The lead links to ?edit=season-anchor&trackId=…#season-edit-season-anchor, so the edit itself lands at the top.
  5. What does the "held" sentence say? Four new held words: fasene, ukene før uke N, de andre sporene and ukene du har satt selv.
  6. How are the marker and the derivation shown? Each changed week is a 44 px row with a Regnet ut marker. A tap opens the derivation in place on motion-collapse (ADR 0030 rule 3). Hand-set weeks are listed under Står som før with Satt selv.
  7. Is a long preview shortened? No. Every changed week is shown, so the confirm applies exactly what was seen.
  8. What does a stale confirm leave? It hides Bruk endringen, says nothing was saved and why, and offers Vis ny forhåndsvisning.
  9. What does a value refusal offer? A button that both pre-fills a fresh start from the first unbegun week with the typed value and shows its preview, one tap and no write.
  10. Critic: what is a fresh start pre-filled with? The week's loading value (target ÷ role factor), so an untouched pre-fill leaves the week as it is. This replaces decision 2's "week N's current target". The helper sentence says the hard weeks are counted from this number.
  11. Critic: how is the confirm reached on a long preview? A sticky footer inside the preview, above the tab bar, with the count and Bruk endringen. Every row stays visible (decision 7 stands).
  12. Critic: how are weeks labelled in the pickers? The same way everywhere: "Fra uke 7 · 15. feb · 128,5 km", with the year when the plan crosses New Year. The held sentence names the edit's own week.
  13. Critic: how are the two stated criteria proven? Server tests: only the machine's untrained sessions in onlyWeekKeys are laid again, and the athlete's sessions and the other weeks are byte-equal. __season-anchor-editor and its tests stay unchanged.
Appendix: critic's scoring, method, rejected directions, code, checklists

Craft: the Regnet ut pill on every row is noise, so make it a text marker and keep the pill for Satt selv. Dim the stale rows under a stale refusal. Move focus to the preview heading after Vis forhåndsvisning. Add the role word to the lead's figure on an easy week ("Uke 47 · lett: 25 km"). Use the motion-collapse primitive for the rows. No motion Block.

Critic's break-ui: (1) Broken: a fresh start from easy week 47 with the pre-fill "34" left as it is changes 6 weeks (wk 48 50 → 34), because the pre-fill is a target, not a loading value. (2) Fragile: the confirm is ~2,000 px down at 29 rows. (3) Ugly: the set and remove pickers have no date. (4) Ugly: the held sentence names week 46 for an edit from week 47. (5) Ugly: the pre-fill follows the week once, not back. (6) Fragile: 4000 km/uke is accepted, and only the rise warning catches it (the schema has no maximum). (7) Ugly: 12 px overflow at 200 % zoom (a 195 px viewport), with min-width:0 as the fix; it holds at 320. Full report: critic.md.

Fit: it reuses EditShell's one form, one digest and one confirm, the held vocabulary, weekRiseWarnings and the ?edit= deep link. Later edit kinds (ramp, boundary step, cuts) join as further acts with no new preview shape. The only one-way door is the lead's row.

Designer's pick

Same variant, Handling først. Disagreement: the designer pre-fills a fresh start with "that week's own target" and would answer the long preview by repeating the headline above Bruk endringen. Critic: on an easy or taper week the target is not an anchor value (the untouched pre-fill cuts 6 weeks by ~30 %), so pre-fill target ÷ role factor; and a repeated headline still leaves the confirm ~2,000 px down, so a sticky confirm footer inside the preview reaches it without hiding rows.

Method

Tool: Emil's prototype (bredvid-design-engineering prototype-ui), standalone branch: one self-contained HTML file with the repo's tokens from app/styles/tailwind.css (light and dark), Public Sans embedded and the PICKER.md picker verbatim. The picker is set to data-position="top" because the toast sits at the bottom. The derivation in the prototype mirrors derive.ts in shape (anchor × ramp over loading weeks, an easy week at 70 % of the last loading week, a taper as a share, an override as the final number) and weekRiseWarnings (loading weeks only, >10 %, a taper ends the search). Its figures are realistic but are not the real engine's.

Driven with Playwright (src/drive.mjs, report in src/drive-report.json): 390, 1440 and 320 px, both datasets, light and dark. Results: no console errors in 7 runs; scrollWidth − clientWidth = 0 in all 16 checks; every text input and select is 16 px at 390 and 14 px at 1440; every control is at least 44 px. The exceptions are the radios inside 44 px+ choice cards and the lead's existing inline event link, which this change does not touch.

Rejected directions

  • Segmentliste: the anchor list with Endre/Fjern on each row, as in the Avansert editor. It reads well, but needs several forms feeding one preview, or one preview per row, which breaks the one-form, one-digest EditShell. It would also duplicate the expert editor.
  • Bare ny start: only "start again from week N". Simplest, but it drops two acts the criteria require (change a value, remove).

Code it touches

  • app/utils/plan-outline/season-edit.ts: SEASON_EDIT_KINDS gains season-anchor; SeasonEdit gains {kind:'season-anchor', trackId, action, fromWeekKey, value}; refusals segment-covers-lived (with the offer's week and value), earliest-segment and segment-not-found; HELD_NUMBERS additions; each after-value's authored | derived marker and derivation (TargetView in outline-preview.ts, or the ReadingMarker of volume-conversion.ts)
  • season-edit.server.ts: anchor writes inside the apply transaction (reusing setSeasonAnchorValue/removeSeasonAnchorSegment rules from authoring.server.ts), and relayPlanFrom with onlyWeekKeys
  • season-edit-schema.ts, season-edit-words.ts, app/utils/labels/plan-domain.ts (SEASON_EDIT_LABELS, SEASON_EDIT_REFUSAL_LABELS, HELD_NUMBER_LABELS), labels/sesong.ts (PLAN_LEAD_LABELS)
  • app/routes/training/__season-edits.tsx (new SeasonAnchorEdit, LINK_FIELDS, the preview's expandable rows) and __season-edits.server.ts
  • __plan-lead-card.tsx, __plan-lead.ts, plan.tsx loader (the volume rows). __plan-advanced.tsx already opens on ?edit= and on the hash

  • Tests: season-edit.test.ts, season-edit.server.test.ts, __season-edits.route.test.tsx, plan.route.test.tsx, tests/e2e/mobile-overflow.test.ts

Verdict: no Block.

mobile-native checklist

Pass: 16 px fields on coarse pointers; 44 px targets (the pill's ::after, choice cards, rows); hover gated to fine pointers; no tap highlight; touch-action: manipulation on controls; no 100vh; the toast sits above the tab bar; safe-area padding on the tab bar. Needs a real phone: the native select sheet with long week options; the inputmode=decimal comma keyboard; the scroll-to-edit after Avansert opens while the keyboard is up; tap delay on the derivation rows.

Handling først Chosen

Working prototype: tap Endre volumet, change the number, Vis forhåndsvisning, tap a week, Bruk endringen. To see the refusal, choose Endre tallet on the season start. To see a stale confirm, press the chrome's Simuler: uke 46 har begynt before confirming.

Critic's worst case

The worst break is in the demo data, not the worst-case data. Choose Start på nytt, pick Uke 47 (lett), leave the pre-filled 34 as it is, and preview. Six weeks drop by ~30 % (week 48 goes from 50 to 34 km). Fix: pre-fill the loading value (target ÷ role factor). Second: on a long preview the confirm sits ~2,000 px down. Fix: a sticky confirm footer inside the preview.
